Defect Title: API returns 422 instead of 404 for nonexistent employee
Defect Description: Employee endpoints return 422 for non-existent IDs while customers/projects endpoints correctly return 404. API design inconsistency.

Defect Title: startDay field returns string instead of integer
Defect Description: /time/time-sheet-period returns startDay as string ("""1""") instead of integer (1). Data type inconsistency.

Defect Title: Projects list endpoint missing customer relationship
Defect Description: Projects list endpoint missing customer data. Detail endpoint includes it. N+1 query problem - clients need N+1 requests for N projects.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. GET /api/v2/time/projects (no customer field)
2. GET /api/v2/time/projects/1 (has customer field)
Actual Result: List missing customer - requires additional requests per project

Defect Title: API does not validate maximum limit value (DoS vulnerability)
Defect Description: API accepts limit=10000 without validation. DoS vulnerability - attackers can exhaust server resources with extremely large limit values.
Actual Result: Status 200 OK - Returns all records without validation

Defect Title: Path traversal vulnerability - Normal users can access admin endpoints
Defect Description: CRITICAL: Path traversal attack allows normal users to access admin endpoints via ../../ URL manipulation. Exposes 188 users' sensitive data. No path normalization or authorization check.
Actual Result: Status 200 OK - Returns all 188 admin users with sensitive info
